The unindexed offline query hit its 115-second command bound. The indexed replay completes without changing the SELECT.
SQLite VM-step counters are signed 32-bit values; the negative global_state counter overflowed. The captured SQL budget is zero while the outer clause budget remains available.
The complete repository gate is separate.
The final three-kernel run passes over all 9,028 inputs. The cumulative 100-check gate is separate.

queryFix.shape: Replace engine-node/call file-leading selection indexes with kind/name and callee indexes. Keep file/id indexes. Index function basename/name. Use the exact literal helper prefix and absence of a later slash in SQL.
